sloka: पापस्य हि फलं दुःखं तद्भोक्तव्यमिहात्मना ।तस्मादात्मापघातार्थं मूढः पापं करिष्यति ।। ७.१५.२४ ॥
transliteration: pāpasya hi phalaṁ duḥkhaṁ tadbhoktavyamihātmanā ।tasmādātmāpaghātārthaṁ mūḍhaḥ pāpaṁ kariṣyati ।। 7.15.24 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, the fruit of sin is sorrow, which one must experience oneself in this world; therefore, only a fool would commit sin for the purpose of self-destruction.
